title: finding(plugin-form,tests): the ModalForm edit case of `editDirtyPayload-10156` failed intermittently in CI with the typed value lost and the whole record sent — `ModalForm` carries none of the first-read gate objectui#10190 gave `DrawerForm`
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a defect with a named site and one CI reproduction (class a: a required check fails on a change that does not touch it). The mechanism is read from source and NOT reproduced locally. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 5 (`session_01KUxVUa7e39aNjhkKi1gsoy`) from the CI of PR objectui#10651 (objectui#10586), which touches only `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/` (and `plugin-form` does not depend on `app-shell`). ⛔ Not graded here.

## The failure (read from the CI log)

- Run `36147629257`, job `108112646062` (`Test (shard 3/8)`), PR head `ae5c50c`, merge-base = `main` `f99f9cd`. It was the one failure in the shard: `Test Files 1 failed | 455 passed | 1 skipped (457)`.
- Test: `packages/plugin-form/src/editDirtyPayload-10156.test.tsx` › `ObjectForm formType modal (ModalForm) edit` › "changing one field sends only that field, with the OCC token it read", at `:313`.
- Expected `ds.update('deal', 'd1', { name: 'Mine v2' }, { ifMatch: VERSION })`. Received one call carrying the WHOLE record with the ORIGINAL name: `{ amount: 10.5, name: 'Mine', qty: '5', remark: null, stage: 'open' }`, with the right `ifMatch`.
- Control: `main`'s own CI passed all eight test shards at `f99f9cd`. The `drawer` (`DrawerForm`) row of the same `describe.each` passed in the same run. ⇒ intermittent, and on the modal arm only.

## What the source says (read, ⛔ not probed)

The received payload is what an edit looks like when the typed change landed BEFORE the first record read, and the landing record then reset the form: the typed value is gone, and every field differs from an empty baseline.

objectui#10190 is the same defect on `DrawerForm`: it painted an editable form while the first read was in flight, and the landing record discarded what was typed. It was fixed by PR objectui#10256 with a `recordReadOutstanding` gate. On `origin/main`:
- `packages/plugin-form/src/DrawerForm.tsx` reads `recordReadOutstanding` 2 times;
- `packages/plugin-form/src/ModalForm.tsx` reads it 0 times, and has its own `loading` state (`:264`, set around its `findOne` at `:413`).

Whether that `loading` state keeps the inputs unmountable or read-only for the whole first read is the claimant's first measurement.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Measure the modal arm the way objectui#10190 measured the drawer. Type into the first rendered input while `findOne` is held open, then release it and submit. If the typed value is lost, give `ModalForm` the same first-read gate, the one objectui#10256 landed. ⛔ Not a test-only retry or a timeout raise.

## Dedupe

Searched this repo with the MCP semantic issue search, including closed issues:
- `editDirtyPayload-10156 test flaky intermittent failure plugin-form` ⇒ objectui#10190 (closed, the `DrawerForm` precedent), objectui#10631 / objectui#10563 (other plugin-form cards), none on this test or `ModalForm`.
- `ModalForm editable while first record read in flight typed value discarded flaky` ⇒ objectui#10190 and objectui#10156 (the origin of the test), and objectui#2968 (closed; a `visibleWhen` flip on the edit modal, a different mechanism). The hits show the instrument is lit.

Dedupe words: `ModalForm first read gate` · `editDirtyPayload-10156 modal flaky` · `recordReadOutstanding ModalForm` · `modal edit typed value lost record lands`
